question: As of 1 April 2023, how many national laboratories does the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR) have in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**37**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR),** renowned for its forefront research and development (R&D) expertise across various scientific and technological domains, stands as a modern R&D institution.
 
• CSIR boasts a vibrant network comprising **37 national laboratories, 39 outreach centers,** 1 Innovation Complex, and three units with a widespread presence throughout India.
 
• Encompassing a broad spectrum of scientific and technological fields, CSIR's areas of focus span from oceanography, geophysics, chemicals, and drugs to genomics, biotechnology, and nanotechnology, as well as extending to mining, aeronautics, instrumentation, environmental engineering, and information technology.
 
• CSIR plays a crucial role in providing significant technological advancements across numerous societal domains, including environment, health, drinking water, food, housing, energy, and both farm and non-farm sectors.
 
• Moreover, CSIR contributes significantly to the development of human resources in science and technology, underscoring its pivotal role in shaping the landscape of scientific and technological innovation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• According to the S**cimago Institutions Ranking World Report 2021, CSIR** is distinguished as the sole Indian institution ranked within the top 100 global government institutions, securing the 37th position out of 1,587 government organizations worldwide. 
 
• In the Asian region, CSIR holds an impressive 7th rank, solidifying its leadership within India as the top-ranked institution.
